# Independent passive-analysis fixtures

Generated by `generate.py` from explicit RFC field layouts, without using the Rust codec.
`session.pcap` and `session.pcapng` contain two four-octet OPENs, an out-of-order UPDATE,
and an origin change. PCAPNG uses interface 1 of two declared interfaces.
`midstream.pcap` requires the supplied context (JSON is valid YAML).
`routes.mrt` contains a TABLE_DUMP_V2 peer index and one IPv4 RIB entry.
IP/TCP checksums are zero, as can occur with capture offload; checksum validation is not asserted.
